name: zella
description: Let Claude edit videos in the Zella app on your Mac, and see the result: cut pauses, captions, voice cleanup, music, looks, zooms, blur, titles and export. Your video file stays on your Mac.

connection_code.title: Zella connection code
connection_code.description: In Zella, choose Claude in the Zella menu, turn on Let Claude edit in Zella, then click Copy.
